note: Literature across cohorts confirms speech and expressive language delay is a predominant feature in FBXO11-related neurodevelopmental disorder (e.g., 95% in a recent 21-patient series and highlighted since Gregor et al. 2018).

evidence.text: Speech delay was observed in 20/21 cases (95%), with expressive language delay being prominent.
